findings.message: Allow voluntary context switches with preemption disabled. On SMP builds with `configUSE_TASK_PREEMPTION_DISABLE == 1`, this guard rejects voluntary switches as well as preemption. If a task disables preemption and then calls `vTaskDelay()`, a blocking queue operation, or `vTaskSuspend(NULL)`, it is removed from the ready list but continues executing because `vTaskSwitchContext()` refuses to select another task. Even an explicit `taskYIELD()` no longer works. Preserve voluntary/blocking switches rather than treating the preemption-disable flag as a scheduler suspension.
